storylines.title: Acme INV-001 paid and reconciled
storylines.description: Clean three-way match, approval, ACH, exact cash match, AP/cash close tie, forecast actual, audit sample, reporting trace.
steps: Vendor invoice INV-001 arrives and matches PO-101 / GR-101
Month-end cash and AP recs tie on this item
Forecast replaces the planned outflow with the bank actual
Auditor samples INV-001 and re-performs three-way match
Reporting can trace any related variance to INV-001

storylines.title: Helios wire received net of a $25 fee
storylines.description: INV-017 is paid by wire. Bank posts $10,025.00; books show $10,000.00. Fee evidence supports FEE_NETTED.
steps: Bank TXN-2026-09-011 is $25 higher than GL-AP-WIRE

storylines.title: Northstar $12.40 unexplained difference
storylines.description: PAY-006 / INV-AR-013 books $12,400.00; bank posts $12,412.40. No fee evidence. Close stays blocked.
steps: Auditor samples the recon for human review
Forecast actuals still point at PAY-006 / TXN-2026-09-015
